expectedBehavior: A human reviewer should be able to find Review Sprints that are not the current Active Sprint, inspect their state, and perform allowed human-authorized transitions such as Review -> Backlog.
notes: Observed after SP-036 was moved to Review during reprioritization to EP-024/SP-037.
The current active Sprint is SP-037, so current-Sprint UI affordances do not expose SP-036.

This is distinct from I-0025. I-0025 covers workflow authority and policy for returning Active or Review Sprints to Backlog. This issue covers AgileCockpit access to non-current Review Sprints and their allowed actions.

Resolution: AgileCockpit Sprint Work now lists Review Sprints separately from the current Active Sprint, lets the human select a Review Sprint, shows its Epic, Tasks, Issues, and status, and provides a Return to Backlog action that applies the canonical Review -> Backlog transition, records audit, refreshes state, and regenerates projections.

Evidence: xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests/AgileCockpitTests/agileCockpitReturnsNonCurrentReviewSprintToBacklog passed on 2026-07-06. xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests passed on 2026-07-06. swift test --package-path AirframeCore passed on 2026-07-06. swift test --package-path AICockpit passed on 2026-07-06.
observedBehavior: AgileCockpit exposes the current Active Sprint as the primary Sprint surface. When SP-036 is in Review and SP-037 is Active, there is no visible UI path to select SP-036, inspect it, or perform the policy-allowed Review -> Backlog transition.
reproductionSteps: Open AgileCockpit with SP-037 as the active Sprint and SP-036 in Review.
Navigate to the Sprint controls or current Sprint surface.
Observe that the UI focuses on SP-037.
Attempt to find SP-036 as a non-current Review Sprint.
Observe that there is no UI path to view SP-036 or move it back to Backlog.

workItem.title: AgileCockpit cannot view or modify non-current Review Sprint
